leads.summary: Inito makes an at-home fertility monitor that measures estrogen, LH, PdG and FSH in about 10 minutes and uses AI to turn the readings into personal ovulation insights for consumers.
leads.hook: Your site says the monitor reads four hormones on separate tracks and double-checks every test with fluorescence and colorimetric imaging.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault turns a health report into a plain-language AI explanation under safety rules against diagnosis, the same job as explaining Inito's hormone readings to a consumer.

leads.summary: Aviator is a developer tool that routes pull requests to the right reviewer, checks each PR against its acceptance criteria and team invariants, and merges and deploys without breaking main, for engineering teams.
leads.hook: Your product page's demo flags an httpx.post call in webhooks/retry.py that has no timeout, and the fix is in the same review.
leads.angle_reason: Canopy's static analysis and deterministic cross-file call-graph resolution is the same kind of code understanding Aviator needs to verify a PR against the code it changes.

leads.angle_reason: MedVault is an LLM pipeline with a fixed output schema and safety rules for a regulated domain, the same constraints Rulebase's AI QA layer has to meet in regulated customer operations.

leads.summary: AgentMail is an email inbox API for AI agents: each agent gets its own inbox with threads, messages, attachments, permissions, and per-customer pods to keep customer data separate.

leads.angle_reason: AgentMail's permissions and per-customer pods isolate data per agent and per customer, the same per-user isolation MedVault enforces at the queryset level in a Django REST API.
